description: Provenance for docs/contract.json. Every element of the contract is derived from the VMware Cloud Foundation 9.0 SDDC Manager OpenAPI specification, not from a rendered documentation page.

sources.name: VMware Cloud Foundation SDDC Manager OpenAPI specification (9.0.0.0)
sources.infoTitle: VMware Cloud Foundation API Reference Guide

releaseDisambiguation.note: The same file path exists at tag 9.1.0.0 (commit 3949fc33339fc5ea1b77eadb258f1cf49aa88e26). The 9.1 revision is NOT the source of this contract.
releaseDisambiguation.observedDifference: HostCommissionSpec.storageType enumerates 'VSAN, VSAN_ESA, VSAN_REMOTE, VSAN_MAX, NFS, VMFS_FC, VVOL, VMFS' at 9.0.0.0; the 9.1.0.0 revision additionally lists NFS41 and FC. A contract taken from 9.1 would wrongly accept NFS41 and FC on a 9.0 deployment.
